sentences.text: No: for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, and your case is a floating, non-business loan to an individual.
The residual policy clause applies only to cases other than those covered by that no-charge rule, so it does not create a basis for a 5% charge in this case.
The older RBI directions on foreclosure charges for floating rate term loans were superseded and are no longer in force.
I did not find an in-force source supporting a 5% foreclosure charge on this case, and the bank’s two home-loan agreement copies instead state 2% and 3% pre-payment charges.
